title: Remove failure lifecycle notes
summary: Removed the visible Reports failure lifecycle reason and note inputs while preserving backend lifecycle journal payload requirements with fixed WebView audit reasons.
reason: The operator-facing notes add friction and visual clutter, and the backend still owns lifecycle journal strictness. The UI should not require ad hoc text entry to preview or confirm a failure lifecycle transition.
behavior_before: The Reports failure lifecycle panel displayed Reason and Note inputs, blocked resolve/reopen preview until a reason was typed, and echoed that reason in the confirmation dialog.
behavior_after: The Reports failure lifecycle panel shows only lifecycle action buttons. Resolve/reopen preview and confirmation no longer require operator text, while the WebView still sends fixed non-empty audit reasons and an empty operator_note for backend-required transitions.
